This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3263(a) documents tiṉ/tinn- eat, with Tamil past tiṉṟ-, Kannada tind-, Kodagu timb-/tind-, Kota/Toda tiḏ- and Gadaba tin-/tiy-/tinḍ-. Selected simple and ordinary tense/nominal forms retain that eat stem and its documented alternants; survey endings, voicing and vowels are preserved. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
